disclaimer.openRouterNotice: OpenRouter traffic only, not total market use. Rankings and token volumes reflect API gateway volume routed through OpenRouter endpoints, not proprietary subscription or local offline usage.
disclaimer.missingDataRule: Missing or unpublished metrics are marked as 'n/r' (not reported). Values are never extrapolated, estimated, or imputed.
disclaimer.separateRankingsRule: Rankings are segmented strictly per verified data source to maintain scientific rigor, rather than blended via arbitrary weights.
